$schema-note: Byte budgets for dist/, checked by scripts/postbuild.mjs after every build. Values are KB of Brotli (1 KB = 1024 bytes; woff2, webp and wasm are counted as served). Groups come from the module graph, so splitting chunks differently does not change what is measured. Raise a number only with a reason in the commit message.
$physics-note: Rapier 0.19.3 SIMD: 1.62 MB wasm, 516 KB at Brotli 9 (about 445 KB at 11) plus 13 KB of worker JS. 0.21 is twice the size (soft bodies), so stay on 0.19 unless a needed fix lands.

runtime.$note: Checked by scripts/profile.mjs --ci: 1500 warm-up frames, then 600 measured frames on the capture clock with the replay path. CPU ms per frame (scaled by --throttle); allocation per frame overall and in our own code (src/**, named through source maps); major GCs; forced layouts and style recalcs per frame; no program, texture or geometry created after reveal; renderer counters.
runtime.$targets: Measured on the skeleton (capture clock, warm JIT): 6.0 KB/frame in total, of which three.js uniform uploads and frustum math are 5.5 KB and our src/** code 0.28 KB (mostly doubles boxed at call boundaries in the loop). Ceilings catch regressions; the targets are src/** under 128 B/frame and no major GC in 60 s on a device. Major GCs are reported, not gated, on this shared CI box.

runtimeSoftwareGl.$note: Overrides for --realtime runs on software GL, where frames take 50-200 ms: every frame is a long task and idle-time GCs run between frames. Capture-clock runs (the default) need no overrides.
